title: Higher Education Commission Second Amendment Bill 2021

sections.shortTitle: Higher Education Commission Second Amendment Bill 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE HIGHER EDUCATION COMMISSION (SECOND AMENDMENT) BILL, 2021
THE
HIGHER EDUCATION COMMISSION (SECOND AMENDMENT) BILL, 2021
[AS
PASSED BY THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY]
A
BILL
further
to amend the laws relating to the Higher Education Commission.
WHEREAS, it is
expedient further to amend the Higher Education Commission Ordinance, 2002
(Ordinance No. LIII of 2002) and the Higher Education Commission Ordinance,
2002 (Ordinance No. X of 2021), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1.
Short title and commencement.- (1) This Bill shall be called
the Higher Education Commission (Second Amendment) Bill, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and
from the 26" day of March, 2021.
